verdict_reason: The purity / separation / analogy kernels are unchanged -- k-NN purity over a category's token embeddings, intra-vs-inter cosine, and a 3CosAdd analogy check -- and each computes what its own spec defines; nothing here computes something other than its definition. The round-7 change is the demotion of all 14 `<cat>_purity_matched` twins, and it landed: over 11 models the live output has `_meta_<cat>_purity_matched` and `_meta_<cat>_k_matched` for every category, and 150 keys of which 91 are now unprefixed numeric (was 105).
comparable_reason: THE DEMOTION IS CONFIRMED ON ITS PRIMARY GROUND AND REFUTED ON ITS SECOND. Mean |spearman| with vocab_size over 11 models across the 14 categories: raw <cat>_purity 0.227 vs matched 0.422 -- the twin built to remove the vocabulary confound makes it 1.86x WORSE, which is the ledger's direction and a larger gap than its 0.327 -> 0.386. But the d_model half of the ledger's claim (0.151 -> 0.241) does NOT reproduce: I measure raw 0.353 vs matched 0.199, i.e. the matched form is BETTER on d_model on my panel. Demoting them was right; the reason should be stated as measured, on vocab_size only.
normalized_variant: _meta_<category>_purity_matched (fixed m and k, blake2b-seeded subsample), all 14 categories -- now demoted
github_reason: The category token lists, the purity/separation definitions and the matched-subsample construction are BLME's own; there is no released reference implementation of 'per-category embedding purity' to fetch. Stated explicitly rather than left blank.
paper_reason: No paper publishes a per-category k-NN purity for these 14 categories on these tokenizers. The analogy arm is closest to Mikolov-style analogy accuracy, but on a different (BLME-authored) analogy set, so the published numbers are not comparable.
confounds_reason: Which TOKENS a category maps to is tokenizer-determined, so every column in this task is downstream of the vocabulary. Measured over 11 models: mean |rho| with vocab_size 0.227 (raw purity) / 0.422 (matched); currencies_purity -0.619, singular_plural_purity -0.535, punctuation_purity -0.391. On d_model: prepositions_purity -0.565, colors_purity -0.503, currencies_purity -0.465, mean 0.353. `_meta_cross_model_comparable` is itself emitted as False, which is the honest answer and is now correctly prefixed.
defects: THE ACCURACY COLUMNS STILL REACH THE FEATURE MATRIX -- unfixed from the previous round. feature_selection.PERFORMANCE_LIKE_PATTERNS uses r'\.acc(?:\.|$|_)', which requires a literal DOT before 'acc'; these columns spell it '_analogy_acc_top1'. I checked all four live column names against is_excluded_predictor and every one returns KEPT: present_past_analogy_acc_top1/_top5 and singular_plural_analogy_acc_top1/_top5. They are capability measures (analogy accuracy) entering a structural feature matrix, and they carry vocabulary signal: rho(singular_plural_analogy_acc_top5, vocab_size) = -0.665 and rho(present_past_analogy_acc_top1, vocab_size) = -0.564 over 11 models.

ANSWERING WHETHER THE RAW `<cat>_purity` COLUMNS SHOULD GO TOO: on the measurement, not as a family. Mean |rho| with vocab_size is 0.227 (14 categories, 11 models) -- materially weaker than the 0.422 of the matched twins that were just demoted -- and with d_model 0.353. Two individual columns are the offenders and should be declared or demoted on their own: currencies_purity (rho -0.619 with vocab_size) and prepositions_purity (rho -0.565 with d_model). Demoting all 14 would remove the task's only remaining purity signal for a family-mean association that is half the size of the one just removed.

`_meta_present_past_purity_matched` is 0.0000 on ALL 11 models with std EXACTLY 0 -- with m=10 and k=9 no member of that subsample is ever among another member's 9 nearest neighbours on any model tested. Now `_meta_` so it is inert, but it is a computed-and-emitted constant.
`_meta_multi_digit_purity_matched` is NaN on 4 of 11 models (the category maps to fewer than 10 single tokens for those tokenizers).

purity and purity_matched remain materially different orderings, so they are not two views of one quantity; on my panel the sign disagrees on colors (-0.047 raw vs -0.585 matched with vocab_size), units (+0.102 vs -0.732) and multi_digit (-0.077 vs +0.889).
